primaryTextChecks.text: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

context.text: The LORD said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

geographicalEvidence.reasonJa: イズレエル平野のモレの丘周辺と考えられるが、本文は精密な座標を示さない。

wikipediaRead.supportingParaphraseJa: 記事の聖書節は士師記7:1の「モレの丘」を記す一方、別の聖書用例と樫・平地の訳の揺れも扱う。この記事の現代の丘を士師記の対象地点と確定する根拠にはならない（149–157行）。
